cases.prompt:
You are an office assistant. Write a short internal memo as markdown in a file named memo.md at the workspace root.

Requirements:
- Include headings or labels for Subject, To, and Date.
- Subject is the Q3 office move.
- To is All Staff.
- The body must mention the move date 15 September and that desks stay assigned.
- The last line of the file must be exactly: MEMO_OK

Do not create code or test files.

Read scratch-notes.txt in the workspace. Turn those messy notes into clean meeting minutes in minutes.md.

minutes.md must include:
- a title
- Attendees (include Ada, Lin, and Sam)
- Decisions
- Action items
- the token MINUTES_OK somewhere in the file

Do not copy the scratch notes verbatim. Do not write test files.

workspace_files.scratch-notes.txt:
standup leftover
ada said ship friday if qa green
lin worried about invoice template
sam will ping legal
we agreed: use the new letterhead, delay the banner ads
action: ada send recap, lin fix spreadsheet, sam book legal 30min

cases.prompt:
Create a small department budget as budget.csv in the workspace root.

Rules:
- First row header: Category,Amount
- Include rows for Travel, Meals, and Software
- Include a final row whose Category is Total
- Use only integers in Amount
- The file must contain the token BUDGET_OK either as a comment-free extra last line or inside a cell

This is an office spreadsheet task, not a coding task.

Draft a polite client email in email.md.

Audience: Jordan at Northwind.
Purpose: apologize for a two-day delivery slip and give a new arrival window of Thursday–Friday.
Tone: professional, no slang.
The file must start with a Subject line and include EMAIL_OK on its own last line.

The workspace has draft.md, which is too casual. Edit it in place so it becomes a short formal briefing.

Keep the revenue figure 4.2M. Add a one-sentence summary at the top. The last line must be exactly REPORT_OK. Do not create a second file.

workspace_files.draft.md: hey team lol q2 was kinda wild we hit like 4.2M revenue which is cool i guess. sales did the thing. more later.
